Best three under ₹50,000 from one review page (prices vary by seller):

Lenovo ThinkBook 16, ₹46,990: Ryzen 5 7535HS, 16GB, 512GB, 16-inch 1920x1200 screen. Upgradeable, about 9 hours battery.
Acer Aspire 14 AI, ₹43,999: Snapdragon X, 16GB, 512GB, 14-inch 120 Hz screen. About 15 hours battery, but some older software won't run on it.
Acer Aspire 3 A324-53, ₹40,990: Core i5-1334U, 16GB, 512GB, muted screen colours. About 7 hours battery.

If you want one, the ThinkBook 16 is the safest pick.
